working_definition: Adult VNC cells of the authors' type hemilineage 15B (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2), 5-day-old adults.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that develops from neuroblast NB2-3 during the postembryonic phase of neurogenesis. These are all Notch OFF hemilineage neurons, as the Notch ON hemilineage is eliminated by apoptosis (Lacin et al., 2019). In the adult, these are all glutamatergic motor neurons (Lacin et al., 2019).

justification: The authors' predicted hemilineage 15B (Figure 4). FBbt has no hemilineage 15B term; lineage 15's secondary neurons are its parent (the authors predict no 15A cells). Also the authors' neurotransmitter for this cluster (glutamate): adult glutamatergic neuron (additional match).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00048900 lineage 15 secondary neuron (broad match).

additional_matches.fbbt_definition: Any glutamatergic neuron of the adult.
